`billion-context` sits between **any** agent and its model API, rewriting Anthropic/OpenAI streams with [acp-kernel](https://github.com/ranxianglei/acp-kernel) compression. The model decides **when** and **what** to compress into high-fidelity summaries — not a hard truncation limit.

billion-context README · Why：Long coding sessions blow up context. Each provider charges per token, and once you pass the context window the session degrades or dies. `billion-context` compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so you can run a single session for days — billions of tokens through one context window.

billion-context README · Why：Unlike a host's built-in summarizer, compression here is **incremental, reversible, and prefix-cache friendly**: summaries are written in small ranges, can be decompressed on demand, and the cache prefix stays intact.

billion-context README · Context-management tools：The proxy injects four context-management tools into the conversation; the model calls them itself as context grows, and the proxy executes `compress` server-side so folded ranges stay summarized in history until restored:

billion-context README · Context-management tools：- **`compress`** — fold a message range into a detailed summary.
- **`decompress`** — restore a compressed range when exact details are needed again.
- **`search_context`** — keyword search over compressed summaries and visible messages.
- **`acp_status`** — context-usage overview plus which ranges are still compressible.

billion-context README · Which do I need?：**Native mode vs standalone extensions.** The host-native plugins (`bili plugin install …`) and the standalone in-process extensions (`billion-context-pi`, `opencode-acp`) are **mutually exclusive** — both active means double compression. The installer makes the switch: it replaces the legacy entries (bare name, `npm:` alias, versioned, path form; array or object shape) and snapshots the original config to `.bili-bak` once; a **project-local** install is not touched — remove that one by hand. As a runtime safety net for manual installs, the native entries set `BILLION_CONTEXT_NATIVE=<host>` synchronously at load so a standalone extension can stand down at action time. On the pi side the marker needs `billion-context-pi` **0.1.72+**, and the pi-native entry scans both pi settings files once its proxy is up and warns loudly when it spots a co-resident legacy entry the installer never saw — that warning is the only visible signal while an old `billion-context-pi` silently double-compresses.

billion-context README · Quickstart：Three ways to use it — pick one:

- **Native plugin (most native):** `bili plugin install <client>` — bili
  becomes a plugin inside the client; start the client as usual.
- **Launcher (config-free):** one `bili <client>` command brings up the proxy and
  the client together — no real config file is ever touched.
- **URL change (most universal):** prefix your client's baseURL with the proxy

billion-context README · Quickstart：Ports, briefly (#1660): `bili start` (manual) owns `8787`. Everything a lane
spawns for you (native hooks, launcher lanes) lives in a separate
self-managed zone starting at `18787` — collisions hop +1 and each lane
remembers its drift, so zero-config installs never fight you for a port,
and a deliberate `bili start` daemon is attached by default. Attach is
lane-aware (#2905): a hook rides its own lane's instance first, NEVER
another declared lane's — except lanes you list in
`native.attachLanePriority` — and the 8787 user-zone daemon stays the
LAST-resort fallback. An
upgrade-restart that finds the previous build still draining on the lane's
port waits for it to release (up to 5s) and rebinds the SAME port instead of
drifting (#1723); only a genuinely occupied port hops +1 — and that hop is
now logged loudly.

billion-context README · FAQ：**When does compression happen?** It is model-driven: the injected context
tools are called by the model as context grows, gentle growth nudges
(~50K-token steps by design, adjustable via `compress.nudgeGrowthTokens`)
prompt it along the way, and preflight fires as a hard backstop when the input
alone exceeds the window (#470). Watch it live with `/acp` or the web UI.

billion-context README · FAQ：**Does compression shrink my client's own conversation file?** No — the most
common surprise in very long sessions (#5796). Compression shrinks **what is
sent to the model**: every outgoing request is rebuilt from live blocks plus
summaries, so the wire stays small however long the conversation runs. The
client's stored history is user data — bili never rewrites it. On dsh the
host's auto-compaction is additionally disabled while bili is active (two
compressors must not fight over one history, #1772/#2474/#3354), so the
host-side file grows with every turn: each turn takes longer as it grows
(measured: tens of seconds per turn at ~30K messages, #5796), and the
practical convergence path is to **start a new session** when it gets heavy.
The web session list badges sessions at 5,000+ requests (长会话/slow) as a
reminder that this point has been reached.

billion-context README · FAQ：**Why does the first compaction wait until ~200k?** Compaction does not
trigger on absolute window position but on growth intervals: by default the
first soft compaction fires 50k tokens past the boot content
(`compress.nudgeGrowthTokens`, flat and window-independent). With a boot around
100k — or with the growth step set to ~100k — the first compaction may wait
until ~200k. To make it fire earlier: 1) trim the system prompt, disable

billion-context README · FAQ：**Is bili transparent? How do I turn it off?** Unrecognized endpoints forward
unchanged ([CLIENTS.md](CLIENTS.md)), and every mode reverses cleanly:
`bili plugin remove <client>` for native installs, stop using the launcher
command / env vars / `/bili/` prefix for the other two — traffic goes direct
again immediately.

Yes — point the client at bili, and point bili at the gateway through the

declare their context windows under the providers key

fallback window (r

billion-context README · FAQ：**Where are logs and session data stored?** Log:
`~/.local/state/billion-context/bili.log` (also mirrored to stderr); session
state: `~/.local/share/billion-context/` (XDG-overridable; Windows AV exclusion

billion-context README · Running in Docker：A `Dockerfile` ships at the repository root — it installs the published npm
package at build time (the tested artifact; nothing is compiled in the image)
and runs the proxy as a service:

```bash
docker build -t billion-context .
docker run -d --name bili -p 8787:8787 \
  -v bili-config:/root/.config/billion-context \
  -v bili-data:/root/.local/share/billion-context \

Then point clients' baseURL at `http://<host>:8787/bili/…` exactly like Option 3
above.

billion-context README · Running in Docker：- **Base:** `node:24-slim` — uses the builtin `node:sqlite` storage engine directly (no native-addon download). Don't switch to Node 20 bases: the self-downloaded SQLite engine requires Node ≥ 22 and crashes under 20 (#3341).

Opt back in with `-e ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=1`; pin a release at build time with `--build-arg BILI_VERSION=0.1.197` (default `latest`).
- **Data:** the four mounted dirs hold config, session state, update throttle/lock + cached SQLite engine, and logs respectively. Mount volumes or bind mounts so they survive container replacement; the image also declares them as `VOLUME`s so even a bare `docker run` keeps them out of the container layer.
- **Security:** the container listens on `0.0.0.0:8787` so clients outside it can connect — there is **no authentication**, so expose the port only on a trusted network (same caveat as `--host 0.0.0.0` below). The web UI an

billion-context README · Flags：```bash
bili --port 9000              # change listen port
bili --host 0.0.0.0           # listen on all interfaces (see host note below)
bili --debug                 # verbose logging (also: set "debug": true in config)
bili --passthrough           # forward without compression (smoke-test mode)

Flags override env vars and the config file. `bili --help` lists them all.

billion-context README · Remote agents (`--host`)：By default the proxy binds `127.0.0.1` and only accepts loopback connections. To serve agents on other machines: `bili --host 0.0.0.0` (or your LAN IP); remote agents point their model `baseURL` at `http://<this-host>:<port>/bili/…`.

One exception (#1073): a **local** client relaying a management path (`/__bili/*`, `/__acp/*`) to a **loopback IP-literal** destination is forwarded unmarked; remote peers and hostname destinations keep the internal tunnel marker unconditionally, and management paths stay unreachable through the tunnel even via NAT hairpin. An absolute-form request addressed to the instance's own endpoint on a management path is served locally instead of tunneled (a forward-proxy-style health probe gets a real answer).
- There is **no authentication**: only do this on a trusted LAN or behind a firewall. The `/__bili/` management endpoin

billion-context README · Debugging：`bili --debug` (or env `ACP_DEBUG=1`, or `"debug": true` in config — flag > env > config) logs every `processTurn` (tag counts, token usage), the nudge decision (growth/usage/pendingT1/shouldInject), client headers, and SSE rewrites.

billion-context README · Log file：All logs tee to `~/.local/state/billion-context/bili.log` by default (XDG state dir) and still print to stderr. Override with `"logFile"` in config or `ACP_LOG_FILE` (`off` disables the file). Auto-rotates at 10 MB (`bili.log.old`). Per-request cache-hit stats log as `[acp-usage] round N input=X cached=Y (cache hit Z%)` so you can measure prefix-cache health directly from the log.

billion-context README · Connection lifecycle tuning (#1982)：Client-facing connections close gracefully after the final response: when the proxy initiates the close (`Connection: close`), it waits up to `BILI_POST_RESPONSE_LINGER_MS` (default `5000`) for the client's close signal before releasing the socket, so pooled clients see a clean EOF instead of a possible RST from racing bytes. Related knobs: `BILI_KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT_MS` (idle-reap budget, default `5000`) and `BILI_CLIENT_ERROR_BACKSTOP_MS` (terminal backstop for the error-drain path, default `30000`) — full semantics in [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md#environment-variables).

billion-context README · Self-update：The proxy checks npm on startup and every 3 minutes; a newer version is installed in place and a notice is logged — **restart `bili` to pick it up**, unless you enable opt-in self-restart (`--auto-restart-on-update` flag, env `ACP_AUTO_RESTART_ON_UPDATE=1`, or `"autoRestartOnUpdate": true` in config — default OFF): with zero in-flight requests it verifies the new install, stops accepting connections, drains, spawns a replacement on the same port, and exits once it accepts connections (clients reconnect automatically; session state survives on disk). Safety gates: zero in-flight through the drain window, an install sanity check before re-exec, and a 10-minute cooldown marker so a flapping version can never loop-restart; any failure resumes the original listener and falls back to the plain reminder.

Each instance draws ONE random moment inside a delay window (built-in default **15 min – 48 h**) and upgrades when it arrives; the drawn moment is persisted, so restarts never re-roll. Fleet upgrades therefore spread across the window instead of completing within minutes of a release, leaving time to catch a bad release mid-rollout (#3401/#3600/#3394). The window plus emergency controls live in a public policy file (`auto-update-policy.json` in this repo, fetched anonymously with ETag caching): `hold` freezes automatic upgrades fleet-wide, `blocked` skips listed versions, `pinned` sets an upgrade ceiling. Fail-open by design — an unreachable or malformed file simply falls back to local defaults, and the file can steer timing/skip/pin only, never what gets installed. Per-machine exits: manual `bili update` bypasses `hold`/stagger (still respects `blocked`/`pinned`), `"staggerMinDelayMs": 0` + `"staggerMaxDelayMs": 0` (or `BILI_UPDATE_STAGGER_MIN_MS`/`BILI_UPDATE_STAGGER_MAX_MS`) restore legacy immediate upgrades, and `ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0` disables a

Enable `--auto-restart-on-update` to have it self-restart at a safe point, or run `/acp` (OpenCode hosts today — pi/dsh coverage tracked in #2084) — the status panel appends a one-line staleness warning (running vs installed version) whenever the on-disk install is ahead of the live process. Auto-update only ever replaces disk files and (optionally) the proxy process; **injected code inside the host process only takes effect after the host itself restarts** — so if the injection breaks at runtime mid-session (a disposed agent scope, a disabled plugin), model traffic goes direct and uncompressed until then. billion-context README · Self-update：**Update visibility is silent by default since v0.1.183 (#1977):** routine/recommended releases no longer render an update line on the `/acp` panel footer or in `acp_status` — only a `critical`-tier release surfaces there (`CRITICAL UPDATE READY/AVAILABLE`). The standing ways to check an installed-but-not-restarted release are the stale cues above: web UI banner, the `/acp` one-line warning, and `GET /__bili/status`. Deliberately no always-on nag; the advisory channel (#1481) remains the only auto-visible critical path.

billion-context README · Self-update：When an install keeps failing (unwritable or host-managed dir, network error, …), auto-update no longer re-downloads and retries on every 3-minute cycle forever. After three consecutive failures it backs off exponentially (5 min → 10 → 20 …, capped at 6 h), logs a one-time actionable hint (fix permissions / npm prefix, reinstall user-level, or disable via `"autoUpdate": false` / `ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0`), and logs nothing further about the failure while cooling down (no download, no retry line); it resumes as soon as the failure clears or a different version is targeted (#1603).

billion-context README · Self-update：The same bounded retry now covers the **owner-managed lanes** the global self-update drives instead of writing the copy itself — the dsh desktop in-place copy, the dsh profile bundles, and pi's npm copy (#2192). Each lane keeps its own failure streak keyed by lane + target version, so a persistently broken desktop layout no longer re-downloads the full tarball every cycle (up to ~480 downloads/day per affected machine before the fix); three strikes arms the same exponential cooldown, and the one-time hint names the failing lane and its manual fix (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`, `pi update --extension …`, or recreate the desktop profile). Host-managed instances additionally check on their own slower cadence — 30 minutes plus up to 15 minutes of jitter, tracked under a separate throttle marker — instead of consuming the global 3-minute budget. Failure streaks are shared across every bili process on the machine through a small state file in the cache dir (`.install-backoff.json`), so several running instances don't each burn their own retry budget; a clean `bili plugin update` disarms the dsh profile lane immediately. billion-context README · Stale local DNS after a network/VPN change (#5224)：A **long-lived** standalone proxy can keep holding stale OS-resolver state after a WSL/VPN/TUN topology change — the process caches its system resolver and libuv's `getaddrinfo` does not re-read `/etc/resolv.conf` on its own. Symptom: every model request through the `/bili/` tunnel answers HTTP 502 `tunnel_destination_denied` with detail `unresolvable`, even though a freshly started `bili` resolves the same host fine at that moment and `curl` from a new shell works. Either remedy clears it:
- **Restart the proxy process** — a fresh process re-reads the system resolver. In the launcher lanes and the dsh web-profile lane the proxy is a *separate registered* process (the instance registry), so restarting only the client/host re-adopts the same wedged proxy and does **not** help — you must stop and relaunch the proxy itself. providers, compression tuning, environment variables — lives in
**[CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md)**.

(`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/billion-context/`; override the path with `BILI_CONFIG_FILE`).

- `compress` — three-level compression tuning (global → provider → model): thresholds, nudge cadence, preservation rules, prompts, tiers.
- Server-level blocks — process-wide behavior, including the #2030 additions: `network` (timeouts / retry / keep-alive / preflight cadence), `persist` (session persistence format + tail), `sessions` (cap + GC policy), `update` (registry mirror + check interval), `diagnostics` (dumps, render-tag mode, injection switches), `fakeCompletion`, plus scalars `codexCompact` / `ccrRetrievalTtlMs` / `decompressTmpCap` and extensions `mitm.handshakeTimeoutMs`, `compat.noCacheControl`, `compat.keepResponseId`.

billion-context README · Pi built-in subagents：**Keep only one subagent implementation enabled.** If you use the built-in support, remove or disable other pi subagent plugins (for example, `pi-subagents` or a separately installed `billion-context-pi-subagents`) in both user and project settings to avoid overlapping tools, prompts, or behavior. This disables the three delegate tools, their system-prompt section, and the fleet keyboard shortcut; context compression remains enabled. It does not disable independently installed subagent plugins. More options: [subagent configuration](CONFIGURATION.md#pi).

billion-context README · How sessions work：The proxy keys compression state on **the conversation value the client itself provides, verbatim** (`src/session-id.ts`) — no hashing, no protocol/upstream/API-key dimensions (those mutate mid-conversation and orphaned state exactly when users kept talking, #280/#286). The id stays inside the proxy (state store, persistence, UI label); it is never sent upstream.

billion-context README · How sessions work：Where the value comes from, first hit wins: the plugin's
`x-bili-plugin-conversation` (honored only alongside the `x-bili-plugin`
marker header), then per-client headers (`x-claude-code-session-id`,
`x-grok-session-id`/`x-grok-conv-id`, `x-mavis-session-id`,
`x-opencode-session-id`), then generic
headers (`x-session-affinity`, `x-acp-session`, `x-session-id`,
`x-opencode-session`, `session-id`/`session_id`), then body fields:
`session_id` / `metadata.session_id` on the Responses wire, and
`prompt_cache_key` promoted over the content-fingerprint fallback on the
Responses/OpenAI/Anthropic wires.

| **Codex** | ✅ yes | `body.session_id` / turn-metadata thread id |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ yes | `x-opencode-session-id` header (`ses_…`, the request's own session id; 2.x sends the *parent's* cache-routing affinity in `x-session-affinity`/`X-Session-Id`/`x-opencode-session` alongside it, #2779 — 1.x sent its own id in those instead) |

billion-context README · How sessions work：**omp caveat (#2583/#3556):** on recent OMP builds, default Anthropic (`anthropic-messages`) requests leave the host through OMP's Cowork transport over node:https directly — they never reach bili's fetch layer, so the `prompt_cache_key` stamp is *withheld* there (stamping would leak the field into Anthropic's strict schema → HTTP 400). Since #3556 the `bili omp` launcher lane no longer leaves that hole open by default: unless you set `PI_PROXY` / `PI_PROXY_ANTHROPIC` yourself, the launcher exports `PI_PROXY_ANTHROPIC=<proxy>`, which pushes Cowork onto Bun's fetch and routes it through the proxy like every other lane (compressed and session-visible; the stamped key is consumed and stripped by the proxy). Direct-and-anonymous remains only for native omp mode and for launcher lanes where you pin your own proxy posture; all other omp traffic keeps its stamped identity. Details: [TECHNICAL-NOTES.md](TECHNICAL-NOTES.md).

billion-context README · How sessions work：**Header-less clients (pi-like): anonymous prefix affinity.** With no conversation signal at all, the proxy resolves the session from the replayed history itself (`src/prefix-affinity.ts`, #309): a request reattaches to a stored session only when its history reproduces that session's message chain byte-exactly from position 0; otherwise it gets its own deterministic `pfa-…` session. Consequences (#1262): a **resumed** conversation reattaches to its own session (even after a proxy restart, #499); a **new task with an identical opener does NOT inherit** another conversation's blocks — it mints a fresh, fully separate session; a request with no usable signal at all gets an explicit 400 instead of silently colliding.

billion-context README · How sessions work：Design record and threat model: [SESSION-IDENTITY.md](SESSION-IDENTITY.md). The
message-granularity sibling (why identity is content-derived, not an
assigned id) is [MESSAGE-IDENTITY.md](MESSAGE-IDENTITY.md).

For upstream sticky-routing, the proxy forwards only identity values the
client already supplied (e.g. a body `session_id` is forwarded upstream as
`x-session-id`); it never synthesizes one itself.

billion-context README · How sessions work：**Recommendation:** explicit-id clients are safe to run concurrently. For header-less multi-agent use, prefer the client plugin (stamps a stable id per conversation) or pass an explicit `x-acp-session` header — otherwise prefix affinity still keeps distinct tasks apart (a diverged fork costs one raw resend plus a compression-ladder restart).

billion-context README · Derived (child) sessions inherit the parent's compressed context (#1333, #1362)：A child session (subagent/fork starting from an empty history) reports its lineage at birth — its identity registration carries `parentConversationId` and the proxy records a read-only `derivedFrom` link — so `decompress` / `search_context` fall back along the parent chain for content the child never saw itself (cycle-guarded, depth cap 8). Nothing is copied into the child, the parent is never modified; if the parent is unknown the child simply starts fresh. Per-lane parent signals (pi/omp `parentSession` header, OpenCode V1/V2 `parentID`): [SESSION-IDENTITY.md](SESSION-IDENTITY.md#derived-child-sessions-lineage-at-birth-1333-1362). claude/codex/dsh need nothing here: they share one session id across subagents or have no child-session concept at all.

billion-context README · Running multiple instances (#3633)：**One conversation belongs to one instance for its whole life.** Fold state,
prefix affinity and the summary budget are keyed to a session id whose home is
the client's own history — and the session's rows live in that instance's
`index.db`. There is no shared store between instances: nothing replicates,
nothing fails over, nothing rehydrates a session onto a different instance.

Consequences for anyone tempted to put several instances behind one Service:

billion-context README · Running multiple instances (#3633)：- **Sticky routing is required, and `ClientIP` affinity is the wrong kind.**
  The conversation identity lives in a header or the request body, not the
  source IP — a Service can only hash on IP, so a client pinned to replica N
  silently loses *every* session when replica N dies (buying throughput while
  selling away availability, exactly when you scaled out because of load).
  Correct routing is an L7 proxy hashing a conversation header
  (`x-bili-plugin-conversation`, `x-opencode-session-id`, `x-acp-session`, …)
  onto a backend — and the client actually sending one (header-less clients
  get prefix affinity instead, which an L7 proxy cannot hash).
- **Instance count is volume count.** The state directory is one local
  directory with SQLite in WAL mode (`busy_timeout=5000`); a coherent shared
  `-shm` and working byte-range locks across writers require an RWO volume
  that is never shared. Pointing two instances at the same RWX/NFS path does
  not give you a shared store — it gives you silent corruption behind a
  timeout. One RWO volume per instance, `storage.unified` included: "unified"
  means one store *for that

billion-context README · Running multiple instances (#3633)：**Single machine, multiple installs (#5046).** The topology above covers
deployment replicas; one desktop has a sibling situation: two installs on ONE
machine (e.g. two DSH profiles — desktop + bot, or a global npm copy beside a
host-tree copy) each start their own proxy and, unless isolated, both resolve
the SAME default XDG sessions directory and the same config file. Multiple
processes writing ONE local-disk `index.db` is the SUPPORTED topology
(#5082/#5091) — SQLite WAL is multi-process safe on a local filesystem — so
startup NEVER blocks on a live foreign writer: the peer shows up as an
info-level `[storage] process pid … is also using …` line plus the status wire,
nothing more (policy settled 2026-10-31, withdrawing the #5046/B-era
refuse-to-start for exactly this shape). What genuinely remains hazardous is
two installs walking the SAME *session* concurrently — that case alarms
separately (split-brain contest, #3923). If you still want strictly separate
histories and stores per install, give each its own `BILI_SESSIONS_DIR` (plus
`BILI_CONFIG_FILE` when the config should differ too) through that install's
launcher/pr

billion-context README · Running multiple instances (#3633)：Naming note: `POST /__bili/replicas` creates a session **checkpoint fork**
(from stored checkpoints), not a pod replica — read it as `/__bili/checkpoints`.

billion-context README · Running multiple instances (#3633)：The proxy rewrites each session's state file every turn of a long session; on Windows, real-time AV (Defender), the search indexer, or a sync tool (OneDrive) can lock the sessions dir mid-write, so persists fail with `EPERM` until the lock clears. Fix at the root: add `%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\billion-context\` to your antivirus exclusions (Defender steps included) and keep sync tools off that path — [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md#windows-exclude-the-sessions-dir-from-antivirus-362). The same exclusion also covers the unified-storage `index.db` refusing to open (`unable to open database file`, #3823) — the storage-degrade warning names it as the first suspect.

billion-context README · Session file cleanup (#1082)：Short-lived sessions leave small state files behind that are never resumed. Cleanup is **opt-in** (`BILI_SESSION_GC=1`; off by default — session files are user data, no silent deletion policy): when enabled, bili sweeps the sessions dir at boot and hourly and deletes a file only when BOTH hold — older than `BILI_SESSION_GC_MAX_AGE_DAYS` (default 7 days) AND never compressed with its newest request body ≤ `BILI_SESSION_GC_MAX_TOKENS` tokens (default 1M) — so deletion loses nothing but bytes. CCR content stores follow their session file's lifecycle; compressed sessions are never deleted; every deletion is audit-logged. Full policy: [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md#environment-variables).

billion-context README · Storage maintenance CLI (#3928)：The same store maintenance the panel exposes over HTTP (`POST /__bili/storage/gc`, `POST /__bili/storage/restore`) has a thin CLI layer — no proxy needed, run it on any machine that owns the sessions dir:

billion-context README · Storage maintenance CLI (#3928)：```bash
bili sessions ls                 # id, label, decoded size, last-updated, storage status (active/archived)
bili sessions rm <id>            # full delete (content refcount release incl. media); shrinks index.db afterwards (--no-vacuum skips)
bili sessions archive <id>       # export to archive/archive.jsonl + sweep rows; tombstone keeps label & identity
bili sessions restore <id>       # bring an archived session back from the log line

billion-context README · Storage maintenance CLI (#3928)：`archive`/`restore`/`gc` require the unified store (`BILI_STORAGE_UNIFIED=shadow|full` or `storage.unified` in the config file) — legacy-only installs refuse with a hint. `--days` defaults to `storage.archiveAfterDays` (365). No scheduler: these run on demand. All commands accept `--json`.

billion-context README · Storage maintenance CLI (#3928)：**Full vacuum is an offline operation on large databases (#4612).** `--vacuum full` (the default) rewrites the entire index.db under an exclusive write lock — O(db size), minutes to tens of minutes on multi-GB databases, with no intermediate progress (SQLite's VACUUM is atomic; it cannot be split). Running it while a proxy is serving from the same sessions dir starves that proxy's writes until its storage layer degrades, so `storage gc --vacuum full` **refuses to start when another live process holds the database** (`index.db.lock` pid discipline, #4175): the CLI exits 1 with an actionable message, the panel endpoint returns HTTP 409. Stop the other instance first (or wait for it to exit) and retry; for online-safe shrink use `--vacuum incremental`, which reclaims freed pages in short transactions without taking the exclusive lock. The zero-ref delete sweep itself is batched with per-batch progress output either way.

billion-context README · 从源码安装(开发)：> **风险**:`master` 是开发分支,随时可能处于不可用状态——未发布的改动、跑不过的构建、未验证的修复都可能出现。除非你要改代码、或验证一个还没发布的修复,否则请用上面的 npm 方式装发布版。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context.git
cd billion-context
npm ci
npm run build

`npm link` 之后,在任何目录都能直接用 `bili`。
billion-context README · 常见问题：**怎么查缓存命中率？** 不用翻日志——`/acp-cache` 直接在客户端里打一份**文字总结报告**，顶部带一个可点击的 **Web UI 链接**，点进去是网页版会话页（**折线图 + 逐断点归因**）：

billion-context README · 常见问题：报告四块，一眼定位：**GRAND LEDGER**（总账：总输入/总命中/hit%，直接给出 `HEALTHY` 或异常判定；miss 拆解为 new content 新增内容 / compress re-pay 压缩重付 / upstream-ttl-or-client-rewrite 上游 TTL 或客户端重写）· **FOLD ECONOMICS**（每次折叠的经济账：净省多少、是否回本）· **LINE ITEMS**（只列异常行：hit<85% 或 miss≥5000）。经验值：**压缩本身只吃掉 ≤2%**，健康会话稳在 **95–97%**；低于这个值时，归因按概率排序：①上游缓存 TTL 到期（报告里表现为 stable-prefix miss，top spikes 会点出闲置时长）②切换了模型 ③bili 的 bug（带报告页提 issue）④其他/未知。`/acp-cache [full]` 列每一折每一行；HTTP 同款：`GET /__bili/cache-report`；每个请求的 `[acp-usage]` 行仍会落日志，供深挖。

billion-context README · 常见问题：**`/acp` 显示什么?** 带原生插件的客户端(opencode、dsh)里,`/acp` 直接从代理取当前会话的 ACP 状态面板(会话、块、可压缩区间、用量);首个模型请求到来前显示空闲提示。`/acp-cache [full]` 打印上面的缓存报告。

**能用网页查会话和配置吗?** 能 —— 打开 [http://localhost:8787](http://localhost:8787):总览仪表盘、会话列表(含逐会话详情)、实时日志、配置编辑器、上游连通性测试。「博客」页还在面板内直接渲染发布笔记与长文——随装内置,在线时后台自动从 GitHub master 拉取新文章(约 1 小时节流,离线时回退到内置旧内容),完整文库也在 GitHub Pages。其余功能同样以纯 JSON 提供(`/__bili/stats`、`/__bili/sessions`、`/__bili/config`、…),方便脚本化。

billion-context README · 常见问题：**压缩什么时候发生?** 由模型驱动:注入的上下文工具由模型在上下文增长时自行调用,温和的增长 nudge(按设计固定约 50K token 步长,可用 `compress.nudgeGrowthTokens` 调整)沿途提醒它,仅输入就超窗时预检作为硬兜底触发(#470)。用 `/acp` 或网页界面实时观察。

**压缩会缩小客户端自己的对话文件吗?** 不会 —— 这是超长会话里最常见的意外(#5796)。压缩缩的是**发给模型的内容**:每个出站请求都由存活块加摘要重建,所以对话再长、线上体积也保持小。客户端自己存的对话历史是用户数据 —— bili 从不改写它。dsh 上宿主自带的自动压缩在 bili 激活时还会被一并关闭(两个压缩器不能抢同一份历史,#1772/#2474/#3354),因此宿主侧文件随每一轮增长:文件越大每轮越慢(实测约 3 万条消息时每轮几十秒,#5796),实际可行的收敛路径就是**重开一个新会话**。网页会话列表会对请求数达到 5000+ 的会话打上「长会话/slow」徽标作为提醒。

billion-context README · 常见问题：**为什么第一次压缩要到 ~200k 才触发?** 压缩触发不是按绝对窗口位置、而是按增长区间:默认在开机内容之上增长 50k token 才触发第一次软压缩(`compress.nudgeGrowthTokens` 恒定步长、与窗口无关)。开机 100k 左右、或把 `compress.nudgeGrowthTokens` 设到 100k 左右时,可能都要到 ~200k 才发生第一次压缩。想更早压缩省 token:1.删减系统提示词、关闭不需要的工具、精简 skill;2.把 nudge 调小到 50k 左右;3.开启 lean 功能。完整算例见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md#为什么第一次压缩要到-200k-才触发)。
billion-context README · 常见问题：**bili 是透明的吗?怎么关掉?** 未识别端点原样转发([CLIENTS.zh-CN.md](CLIENTS.zh-CN.md)),且每种模式都能干净退出:原生安装用 `bili plugin remove <client>`,另两种模式停掉启动器命令 / 环境变量 / `/bili/` 前缀即可 —— 流量立刻恢复直连。

billion-context README · 常见问题：**能配合模型路由网关(如 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie))用吗?** 能 —— 客户端指向 bili、bili 经 `/bili/` 前缀指向网关(前缀内嵌网关的绝对 URL):`http://localhost:8787/bili/http://127.0.0.1:3425…`。例:Claude Code → `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/bili/http://127.0.0.1:3425` + `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=magpie`;OpenAI 系客户端 → `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/bili/http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1`(+ `OPENAI_API_KEY=magpie`)。压缩发生在路由*之前*——到达网关节点里任何账号的请求都已是压缩后的。凭据留在网关内:客户端的假 key 原样穿过,真实 key 不接触 bili。注意:① 会话中途切换账号会使 provider 前缀缓存失效——多账号路由的固有代价,与 bili 无关(见 `/acp-cache` 的 KEY SWITCHES 段);② 路由后的模型名对 bili 的窗口查询不透明——需在 providers 键 `http://127.0.0.1:3425` 下用 `models.<name>.context` 声明其上下文窗口,否则按兜底窗口运行(route-miss 警告,#2317);③ 中继若拒绝 bili Anthropic 车道的 `cache_control` 标记,设 `compat.noCacheControl`;④ 回环网关开箱即用;网关在非回环私网地址时可能还需 `network.allowPrivateHttpProviders`(#2984);⑤ Claude Code 原生插件模式(`bili plugin install claude`)下,可在安装前设 `BILI_CLAUDE_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:3425`,受管配置块会自动将其包裹为代理 URL(或直接配置 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787/bili/http://127.0.0.1:3425`;`localhost` 与 `127.0.0.1` 均被正确识别,#5369)。三条线(OpenAI Chat / Responses / Anthropic Messages,含跨协议转换)已端到端实测,#4433。

billion-context README · 常见问题：**日志和会话数据存在哪?** 日志:`~/.local/state/billion-context/bili.log`(同时镜像到 stderr);会话状态:`~/.local/share/billion-context/`(XDG 可覆盖;Windows 杀软排除 #362、可选清理 #1082)—— 完整路径见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)。

billion-context README · 在 Docker 中运行：仓库根目录自带 `Dockerfile`——构建期从 npm 装已发布的包(被测试过的产物;镜像里不编译任何东西),把代理作为服务跑起来:

```bash
docker build -t billion-context .
docker run -d --name bili -p 8787:8787 \
  -v bili-config:/root/.config/billion-context \
  -v bili-data:/root/.local/share/billion-context \

然后把客户端 baseURL 指到 `http://<host>:8787/bili/…`,和上面方式 3 完全一样。

billion-context README · 在 Docker 中运行：- **基础镜像:** `node:24-slim` —— 直接用内置 `node:sqlite` 存储引擎(不发生 native addon 下载)。不要换成 Node 20 基础镜像:自举下载的 SQLite 引擎要求 Node ≥ 22,在 20 上会崩(#3341)。
- **更新:** 容器内自更新**默认关闭**(`ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0`)——容器化副本的合法升级通道是重建/pull 新镜像;原地自更新会在下次重建时被静默回退到镜像版本。想开回来用 `-e ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=1`;构建期钉版本用 `--build-arg BILI_VERSION=0.1.197`(默认 `latest`)。
- **数据:** 四个挂载目录分别存放配置、会话状态、更新节流/锁 + 缓存的 SQLite 引擎、日志。挂 volume 或 bind mount 让它们跨容器替换存活;镜像也把这四个目录声明为 `VOLUME`,裸 `docker run` 也不会把它们落进容器层。
- **安全:** 容器监听 `0.0.0.0:8787` 以便外部客户端接入——**没有认证**,端口只应暴露给可信网络(与下面 `--host 0.0.0.0` 的注意事项相同)。Web UI 和 `/__bili/*` JSON 端点经映射端口照常可用。
- **健康检查:** 镜像自带 `HEALTHCHECK`,用 node 内置 fetch 探 8787 上的 `/__bili/health`(slim 基础无需 curl);若覆盖监听端口,注意探针仍钉在 8787。

billion-context README · 命令行参数：```bash
bili --port 9000              # 改监听端口
bili --host 0.0.0.0           # 监听所有网卡(见下面的 host 说明)
bili --debug                 # 详细日志(也可在配置里设 "debug": true)
bili --passthrough           # 不压缩直接转发(冒烟测试模式)

参数优先级高于环境变量和配置文件。`bili --help` 列出全部。
billion-context README · 远程 agent（`--host`）：默认绑定 `127.0.0.1`,只接受本机连接。要给其他机器上的 agent 用:`bili --host 0.0.0.0`(或局域网 IP);远程 agent 把模型 `baseURL` 指向 `http://<本机>:<端口>/bili/…`。

billion-context README · 远程 agent（`--host`）：- MITM 模式的 `CONNECT` 也会接受远程客户端 —— 但仅限**白名单内的模型域名**;到任意主机的盲隧道仍仅限本机,代理不会沦为开放中继。
- `/bili/<绝对URL>` 目的地准入(#409):代理自身与 link-local/metadata 地址一律拒绝;loopback/私网目的地对本地客户端放行(自托管上游)、对远程客户端拒绝,除非列入 `BILI_TUNNEL_ALLOWED_HOSTS`(`host` 或 `host:port`,逗号分隔)。一个例外(#1073):**本地**客户端经**loopback IP 字面量**目的地转发管理路径(`/__bili/*`、`/__acp/*`)时不带标记放行;远程 peer 与主机名目的地无条件保留内部隧道标记,管理路径即使经 NAT hairpin 也无法穿过隧道。指向本实例自身管理端点的绝对形式请求会在本地直接应答、而不是经隧道转发(正向代理式健康探测能拿到真实响应)。
- **没有任何鉴权**:只应在可信局域网或防火墙内使用。`/__bili/` 管理端点仍仅限本机访问。启动时的 `[security]` 警告会提醒上述事项。

billion-context README · 调试：`bili --debug`(或环境变量 `ACP_DEBUG=1`,或配置里 `"debug": true` —— 优先级:参数 > 环境变量 > 配置)会打印每次 `processTurn`(标签计数、token 用量)、nudge 决策(growth/usage/pendingT1/shouldInject)、客户端 headers 和 SSE 重写。

billion-context README · 日志文件：所有日志**默认同时写入文件**:`~/.local/state/billion-context/bili.log`(XDG state 目录),同时仍打印到 stderr。覆盖用配置的 `"logFile"` 或 `ACP_LOG_FILE`(`off` 关闭文件)。超过 10 MB 自动轮转(`bili.log.old`)。每个请求的缓存命中统计以 `[acp-usage] round N input=X cached=Y (cache hit Z%)` 打印,可直接从日志衡量前缀缓存健康度。

billion-context README · 连接生命周期调优（#1982）：客户端侧连接在最终响应结束后优雅关闭:代理主动发起关闭(`Connection: close`)时,最多等待 `BILI_POST_RESPONSE_LINGER_MS`(默认 `5000`)毫秒的对端关闭信号才释放套接字,池化客户端因此看到的是干净的 EOF,而非字节竞态可能产生的 RST。相关旋钮:`BILI_KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT_MS`(空闲回收预算,默认 `5000`)与 `BILI_CLIENT_ERROR_BACKSTOP_MS`(错误排空路径终局兜底,默认 `30000`)——完整语义见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)。

billion-context README · 自动更新：代理启动时和每 3 分钟检查 npm 是否有新版本。发现新版本就原位安装并打印通知 —— **重启 `bili` 才能生效**,除非启用可选自重启(`--auto-restart-on-update` 参数 / `ACP_AUTO_RESTART_ON_UPDATE=1` 环境变量 / 配置 `"autoRestartOnUpdate": true`,默认关闭):零在途请求时校验新安装、停止接收连接、排空、在同一端口拉起替代进程并在其开始接受连接后退出(客户端自动重连;会话状态在磁盘上保留)。安全门:排空窗口全程零在途、re-exec 前安装完整性检查、10 分钟冷却标记防止版本抖动循环重启;任何失败恢复原监听器并回落到普通提醒。运行进程落后于磁盘安装("stale")时,Web UI 显示横幅,`GET /__bili/status` 返回 `{version, diskVersion, stale, autoRestartOnUpdate, advisory, updatePolicy, inFlight}` 供脚本使用(`advisory` 为生效中的严重缺陷公告或 `null`,见下节;`updatePolicy` 上报 #3619 撒点状态——策略来源、`hold`/`pinned`/`blocked`、以及待执行的撒点升级及其到点时刻)。永久禁用:配置(`"autoUpdate": false`)或环境变量(`ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0`)。

billion-context README · 自动更新：**升级撒点(#3619):** 发现新版本后,自动更新不再立即应用。每台实例在延迟窗口内随机抽取**一个**时刻(内置默认 **15 分钟 – 48 小时**),到点再升;抽中的时刻落盘持久化,重启不重摇。全量升级因此摊开在整个窗口内,而不是发版后十几分钟内全体升完,给坏发版留出中途拦截的响应窗(#3401/#3600/#3394)。窗口与紧急控制放在一个公开的策略文件里(本仓库的 `auto-update-policy.json`,匿名 GET + ETag 缓存):`hold` 全局冻结自动升级、`blocked` 跳过指定版本、`pinned` 设置升级天花板。按设计 fail-open——文件不可达或格式非法时直接回退本地默认;而且它只能调节奏/跳过/钉住,**永远控制不了装什么**。本机退出方式:手动 `bili update` 绕过 `hold`/撒点(但仍遵守 `blocked`/`pinned`)、`"staggerMinDelayMs": 0` + `"staggerMaxDelayMs": 0`(或 `BILI_UPDATE_STAGGER_MIN_MS`/`BILI_UPDATE_STAGGER_MAX_MS`)恢复旧版立即升级、`ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0` 完全停用自动更新。完整格式与语义见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md → `update`](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md#update)。

billion-context README · 自动更新：**插件模式**(`bili opencode` / `bili pi` / `bili dsh` —— 代理内嵌在长驻宿主里运行时),"重启 bili"指的是重启**宿主**:内嵌进程无法自行退出,所以一直开着的宿主会持续运行它启动时的那份代码,默默地错过自动更新报告为"已安装"的每一处修复(#1603)。启用 `--auto-restart-on-update` 可让它在安全点自重启;或运行 `/acp`(当前仅 OpenCode 宿主,pi/dsh 覆盖见 #2084)—— 当磁盘安装领先于运行进程时,状态面板会追加一行过期警告(运行版本 vs 已安装版本)。若注入代码在运行期损坏(如 agent scope 被销毁),模型流量会静默直连(不压缩),直到宿主重启;自 #3581 起该状态可见:无会话运行时插件上报归属闸门降级,Web UI 显示「接管已失效」横幅,`GET /__bili/status` / `/__bili/overview` 暴露每代理的 `attribution` 状态。**按设计无归属**的后台车道(如 dsh 标题生成 sidecar)本身不携带 initiator,其小体量一次性请求按定义直连——按 #3651 契约这类正常拦截**永不报告**,因此永远不会触发横幅。横幅只在归属查询本身抛错(宿主内部错误,如 agent scope 被销毁)时出现,并给出可诊断信息:抛出的错误文本、脱敏后的端点、起始时间、已直连的请求数、解决方法(重启宿主进程),以及复制/提交诊断按钮(预填 GitHub issue)。

billion-context README · 自动更新：**自 v0.1.183 起,更新提示默认静默(#1977):**routine/recommended 版本不再在 `/acp` 面板脚注或 `acp_status` 中渲染更新行 —— 只有 `critical` 级别的版本会在那里显示(`CRITICAL UPDATE READY/AVAILABLE`)。检查"已安装未重启"版本的常设途径即上文所列的过期线索:Web UI 横幅、`/acp` 单行警告、以及 `GET /__bili/status`。刻意不设常驻提醒;严重缺陷公告通道(#1481)仍是唯一自动可见的严重路径。

billion-context README · 自动更新：当安装反复失败(目录不可写或受宿主托管、网络错误等)时,自动更新不再每个 3 分钟周期都重复下载并重试。连续失败三次后,它按指数退避(5 分钟 → 10 → 20 …,上限 6 小时),打印一次性的可操作提示(修复权限 / npm prefix、以用户级重装,或用 `"autoUpdate": false` / `ACP_AUTO_UPDATE=0` 禁用),并在冷却期间不再为这次失败输出日志(不下载、不打重试行);一旦故障消除或目标版本变化即恢复(#1603)。

billion-context README · 自动更新：同样的有界重试现在也覆盖全局自更新代为驱动的 **owner 托管通道** —— dsh desktop 原位副本、dsh profile bundle 与 pi 的 npm 副本(#2192)。每条通道按「通道 + 目标版本」维护独立的失败计数,desktop 布局持续损坏时不再每周期重新下载整个 tarball(修复前每台受影响机器每天最多约 480 次下载);连续失败三次进入同样的指数冷却,一次性提示会指明出错的通道与手动修复方式(`dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`、`pi update --extension …`,或重建 desktop profile)。宿主托管实例另走更慢的独立检查节奏 —— 30 分钟加最多 15 分钟抖动,记在独立的节流标记里 —— 不再占用全局 3 分钟预算。失败计数通过缓存目录下的一个小状态文件(`.install-backoff.json`)在机器上所有 bili 进程间共享,多个运行中的实例不会各自烧掉独立的重试预算;`bili plugin update` 成功一次会立即解除 dsh profile 通道的冷却。该文件以原子方式写入(tmp+rename),且每次写入都与磁盘上已有内容合并,并发实例互相协作而不是覆盖彼此的计数;长驻进程会在文件变化时重新读取,任一副本执行的手动解除会在其它副本的下次检查时可见。它的一切失败模式都偏向重试 —— 损坏的文件或时钟跳跃会被丢弃,绝不允许长期沉默某条更新通道。`bili plugin update` 清除 dsh profile 通道的键;修复好的 desktop 通道则在下次成功的原位刷新时清除自己的键。

billion-context README · 网络/VPN 切换后本地 DNS 陈旧(#5224)：**长驻**的独立代理在 WSL/VPN/TUN 拓扑变化后可能一直持有陈旧的 OS 解析器状态 —— 进程会缓存其系统解析器,而 libuv 的 `getaddrinfo` 不会自行重读 `/etc/resolv.conf`。症状:经 `/bili/` 隧道发出的每个模型请求都返回 HTTP 502 `tunnel_destination_denied`(detail `unresolvable`),尽管同一时刻新起的 `bili` 能正常解析同一主机、新 shell 里的 `curl` 也正常。两种解决办法任选其一即可清除:
- **重启代理进程** —— 新进程会重读系统解析器。在 launcher 车道和 dsh web-profile 车道里,代理是一个**独立登记的**进程(instance registry),所以只重启客户端/宿主会从 registry 重新收养同一个楔死的代理,**不起作用** —— 必须停掉并重新启动代理本身。(内嵌插件模式下代理跑在宿主内部,重启宿主**能**清除。)
- **让出口走上游代理** —— `-F http://<host:port>` 或 `BILI_UPSTREAM_PROXY=… BILI_UPSTREAM_PROXY_MODE=auto`:目标改由那个上游代理远端解析,bili 准入时不再查询自己(已陈旧的)解析器。
section: 网络/VPN 切换后本地 DNS 陈旧(#5224)

text: billion-context README · 严重缺陷公告(强制更新)：该检查默认 fail-open:公告源不可达或格式错误只产生警告,绝不阻断模型流量。禁用方式:配置(`"advisoryCheck": false`)或环境变量(`BILI_ADVISORY_CHECK=0`);可用 `"advisoryUrl"` / `BILI_ADVISORY_URL` 指向自定义文档。**公告（Announcements）**（#5548）——与上面的关键缺陷公告是两回事：三个来源给 Web UI 提供横幅，相同 id 的覆盖顺序为**本地文件 > 远程源 > 内置**：(1)*内置*——一次性提示，直接走界面内置文案；(2)*本地*——把 JSON 文件放进配置目录的 `announcements/*.json`（默认 `~/.config/billion-context/announcements/`）即自动渲染：双语记录、按 kind 定色、npm 风格 `versions` 版本定向（`>=a.b.c`、`^`、`~`、`[lo hi]`、`||` 列表）、`percent` 灰度、时间窗、按类型排优先级——一个坏文件只废掉它自己；(3)*远程*——本仓库 master 分支的 [`announcements/remote.json`](announcements/remote.json)（每个 PR 都过 CI 校验），约每 3 分钟拉取一次，上一份有效公告的快照可跨重启/断网存活，坏推送会被拒绝；无法直连的环境用 `"remoteAnnouncementsUrl"` / `BILI_ANNOUNCEMENTS_URL` 指向同一文档的中继镜像。关闭行为按每条记录声明的模式：`persistent`（默认，按内容寻址——公告内容改动后会再提示一次）、`instance`（仅本进程）或 `always`（不显示关闭按钮）。关闭内置提示的记录按安装持久化在统一存储里（默认 SQLite，MySQL 后端同样可用），重启后不复发；旧的 `upgrade-notices.json` 状态文件只作为无统一存储边车（如显式加密 opt-out）的旧式安装的回退。官方源当前发布的是空条目列表。

billion-context README · 配置：完整的配置参考 —— 配置文件位置、顶层键、providers、压缩调参、环境变量 ——
见 **[CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)**。

billion-context README · 配置文件：一份 JSON 文档:`~/.config/billion-context/billion-context.json`
(`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/billion-context/`;用 `BILI_CONFIG_FILE` 可改路径)。
同一开关有多个来源时的优先级:**CLI 参数(如有)> 环境变量 > 配置文件 > 内置默认值** —— 每个环境变量都继续作为覆盖层可用。

里面有什么(细节见 CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md):

billion-context README · 配置文件：- `providers` —— 按 provider 的路由表:上游覆盖、模型上下文窗口、按 provider/模型的压缩调参、wire 协议声明、compaction opt-in。
- `compress` —— 三级压缩调参(全局 → provider → 模型):阈值、nudge 节奏、保留规则、prompts、tiers。
- 服务端级配置块 —— 进程级行为,含 #2030 新增:`network`(超时 / 重试 / keep-alive / preflight 节奏)、`persist`(会话持久化格式 + tail)、`sessions`(上限 + GC 策略)、`update`(registry 镜像 + 检查间隔)、`diagnostics`(dump、render-tag 模式、注入开关)、`fakeCompletion`,以及标量 `codexCompact` / `ccrRetrievalTtlMs` / `decompressTmpCap` 和扩展项 `mitm.handshakeTimeoutMs`、`compat.noCacheControl`、`compat.keepResponseId`。

billion-context README · 配置文件：最小示例:

```json
{
  "network": { "upstreamTimeoutMs": 900000 },
  "persist": { "zstd": true },
  "sessions": { "gc": { "enabled": true, "maxAgeDays": 14 } }

最常找的开关:

billion-context README · 配置文件：- **上游代理(防火墙/GFW)**—— 让代理自身出站流量走 v2rayA/clash:完整解析顺序、空字符串 = 显式直连、SOCKS5 拒绝、两条出站路径都覆盖,以及 `mitm://` vs `https://` 键 scheme 区分,都在 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)(服务端设置 → `proxy`;Providers → key schemes)。
- **线上兼容角色改写(`compat.roles`)**—— 上游拒绝 `developer` 角色?[CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)(服务端设置 → `compat`)已覆盖 —— 包括零配置即用的失败自学习修复。
- **签名上游(body 级签名)**—— 请求携带 body 级签名的网关(CodeArts APIG 的 `SDK-HMAC-SHA256`,或 `x-ofm-signature` 一类网关自造头):内置方案在 dsh 上透明重签;其他被形状检测识别出的方案**一律本地拒收** —— 签名请求要么重签+压缩、要么拒绝,绝不无签名放行 —— bili 在补上对应重签器前每次启动与 web UI 持续提醒(#1884/#2090)。检测规则、按方案覆盖、`BILI_RESIGN` / `BILI_RESIGN_PASSTHROUGH` / `BILI_CODEARTS_REF` 见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)(服务端设置 → `resign`)。

billion-context README · Pi 内置子代理：使用 `bili pi` 或 pi 原生插件（`bili plugin install pi`）时，会自带默认启用的子代理功能：`acp_delegate`、`acp_delegate_wait` 和 `acp_delegate_cancel`。这组额外工具仅在 pi 上提供。

**建议只启用一套子代理实现。** 如果使用内置功能，建议在用户级和项目级配置中移除或禁用其他 pi 子代理插件（例如 `pi-subagents` 或单独安装的 `billion-context-pi-subagents`），避免工具、提示词或行为重叠。如果更喜欢其他子代理插件，可以关闭内置功能。`pi-subagents` 在任一作用域（项目级或用户级）的安装都会让内置 delegate 自动让位（#5637）——用户级安装在每个项目中都会加载，因此该保护同样适用；如需与其并存保留 `acp_delegate`，设置 `delegate.forceEnable`。
billion-context README · 会话机制：代理以**客户端自己提供的会话值(原样照搬)**为键隔离压缩状态(`src/session-id.ts`)—— 不哈希、不含协议/上游/API key 维度(它们会在会话中途变化,拿它们做 key 恰好在用户继续对话时把状态弄丢,#280/#286)。该 id 只在代理内部使用(状态存储、持久化、UI 标签),绝不上送。

billion-context README · 会话机制：取值来源(按顺序取第一个命中的):插件的 `x-bili-plugin-conversation`(仅当同时带 `x-bili-plugin` 标记 header)、客户端专属 header(`x-claude-code-session-id`、`x-grok-session-id`/`x-grok-conv-id`、`x-mavis-session-id`、`x-opencode-session-id`)、通用 header(`x-session-affinity`、`x-acp-session`、`x-session-id`、`x-opencode-session`、`session-id`/`session_id`)、或 body 字段:Responses wire 的 `session_id`/`metadata.session_id`,以及 Responses/OpenAI/Anthropic wire 上提升替代内容指纹回退的 `prompt_cache_key`。

billion-context README · 会话机制：| 客户端 | 发会话 id 吗? | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| **Codex** | ✅ 发 | `body.session_id` / turn-metadata thread id |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ 发 | `x-opencode-session-id` header(`ses_…`,请求自身会话 id;2.x 同时在 `x-session-affinity`/`X-Session-Id`/`x-opencode-session` 里携带*父级*缓存路由亲和值,#2779 —— 1.x 在这些 header 里发送的是自身 id) |
| **Claude Code** | ✅ 发 | `x-claude-code-session-id` header |
| **omp**(经插件)| ✅ 发 | `prompt_cache_key` 提升为稳定身份(#268)|
| **pi**(裸跑)| ❌ 不发 | 无 → 见下方匿名前缀亲和 |

billion-context README · 会话机制：**omp 注意(#2583/#3556):** 较新的 OMP 构建中,默认 Anthropic(`anthropic-messages`)请求经 OMP 的 Cowork 传输以 node:https **直发** —— 到不了 bili 的 fetch 层,因此那条路径上 `prompt_cache_key` 打戳被*主动放弃*(打了戳反而会把字段泄漏进 Anthropic 严格 schema → HTTP 400)。自 #3556 起,`bili omp` launcher lane 默认不再留这个洞:除非你自己设置了 `PI_PROXY` / `PI_PROXY_ANTHROPIC`,launcher 会导出 `PI_PROXY_ANTHROPIC=<proxy>`,把 Cowork 推回 Bun 的 fetch、像其余 lane 一样经代理路由(可压缩、会话可见;打上的 key 由代理消费并剥离)。直连且匿名的行为只保留在 native omp 模式、以及你自己钉死代理姿态的 launcher lane;其余 omp 流量保持打戳身份。详见 [TECHNICAL-NOTES.zh-CN.md](TECHNICAL-NOTES.zh-CN.md)。

billion-context README · 会话机制：**无 header 客户端(pi 类):匿名前缀亲和。** 当客户端完全不发任何会话信号时,代理从重放的历史本身解析会话(`src/prefix-affinity.ts`,#309):只有当请求历史从第 0 条开始逐字节复现某已存会话的消息链时,才重新挂回该会话;否则获得一个确定性的新 `pfa-…` 会话。后果(#1262):**恢复(resume)** 的对话重新挂回自己的会话(包括代理重启后,#499);**开头相同的新任务不会继承**另一个会话的 block —— 它拿到全新会话,历史一旦分叉就彻底独立;完全没有任何可用信号时,请求会被显式 400 拒绝,而不是静默与他人状态碰撞。

设计记录与威胁模型:[SESSION-IDENTITY.md](SESSION-IDENTITY.md)。消息粒度的对偶文档(为什么身份由内容派生、而非指派 id)是 [MESSAGE-IDENTITY.zh-CN.md](MESSAGE-IDENTITY.zh-CN.md)。

billion-context README · 会话机制：上游粘性路由方面,代理只转发客户端本来就提供的身份值(例如 body 里的 `session_id` 会以 `x-session-id` 上送),绝不自行合成一个。

**建议:** 发显式 id 的客户端可以安全并发。无 header 的多 agent 场景,优先装客户端插件(为每个会话盖稳定 id)或每会话传显式 `x-acp-session` header —— 两者都没有时,前缀亲和也能把不同任务分开(分叉的代价只是一次原始重发加压缩阶梯重启)。

billion-context README · 派生(子)会话继承父会话的压缩上下文(#1333、#1362)：当 agent 派生子会话(subagent 或 fork,从空历史起步、不重发父会话内容)时,它会在出生时上报这条血缘:身份注册携带父会话 id(`parentConversationId`),代理在子会话上记录一条只读链接(`derivedFrom`)。此后 `decompress` / `search_context` 对子会话自己从未见过的内容沿父链回退(带环检测、深度上限 8);任何东西都不复制进子会话,父会话也绝不被修改;父会话未知时子会话就按全新起步。各 lane 的父信号(pi/omp `parentSession` header、OpenCode V1/V2 `parentID`):[SESSION-IDENTITY.zh-CN.md](SESSION-IDENTITY.zh-CN.md#派生子会话出生时携带血统1333-1362)。claude/codex/dsh 在这里不需要任何信号:它们的子 agent 共享同一个会话 id,或根本没有子会话概念。
section: 派生(子)会话继承父会话的压缩上下文(#1333、#1362)

text: billion-context README · Windows：把会话目录加入杀软排除项（#362）：代理把每个会话的压缩状态持久化到会话目录(默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\billion-context\`),长会话每一轮都会重写该文件。在 Windows 上,实时杀毒(Defender)、搜索索引器或同步工具(OneDrive)可能在写入中途锁住该目录,导致 rename 以 `EPERM` 失败。同一会话连续 N 次写失败(默认 `5`)时,代理打一条一次性可操作告警,指明要排除的目录。根上修复:把 `%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\billion-context\` 加入杀软**排除项**,并确认没有同步工具在同步该路径 —— 完整步骤见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md) 的「Windows：把会话目录加入杀软排除项」章节。同一排除项也覆盖统一存储 `index.db` 打不开(`unable to open database file`,#3823)——存储降级告警会把它列为第一嫌疑。
section: Windows：把会话目录加入杀软排除项（#362）

text: billion-context README · 单机多安装共存（#5046）：同一台机器上装了**两份及以上** bili（例如两个 DSH profile——桌面端 + bot，或全局 npm 拷贝与宿主树拷贝并存）时，各自的代理默认都解析到**同一个** XDG 会话目录（`%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\billion-context\sessions\`）和同一份配置文件。开了统一存储（`storage.unified` = shadow/full）后，两个进程会双写同一个 `index.db`：日志出现 `[instances] another bili instance is running …`，lane 重叠时还有 `[storage] … two processes on one index.db corrupt it` 级别的 error；SQLite 写锁争用（`SQLITE_BUSY` / `database is locked`）会让整轮模型请求直接失败，持续双写还有损坏风险。正确做法是**隔离**：给每份安装设独立的 `BILI_SESSIONS_DIR`（配置也要分开时再加 `BILI_CONFIG_FILE`），只加在该安装自己的启动器/profile 环境变量里，不动全局环境。隔离后两份可正常并存，`[instances]` 提示会自动降为 info 级（目录不同 ⇒ 无共享状态）。

billion-context README · 会话文件清理（#1082）：短命会话会留下永远不会再被恢复的小状态文件。清理是**可选开启(opt-in)**的:设 `BILI_SESSION_GC=1` 才启用(默认关闭 —— 会话文件属于用户数据,不应有静默删除策略)。启用且持久化开启时,bili 在启动时和每小时扫描会话目录,只有**两个条件同时满足**才删除一个文件:年龄超过 `BILI_SESSION_GC_MAX_AGE_DAYS`(默认 7 天),并且该会话**从未被压缩过**(没有折叠块)、最近一次请求体 ≤ `BILI_SESSION_GC_MAX_TOKENS` token(默认 1M)—— 删除只丢字节不丢内容。CCR 内容存储遵循其会话文件的生命周期;被压缩过的会话永不删除;每次删除都写审计日志。详见 [CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md](CONFIGURATION.zh-CN.md)。

billion-context README · 存储维护 CLI（#3928）：面板通过 HTTP(`POST /__bili/storage/gc`、`POST /__bili/storage/restore`)暴露的同一套存储维护操作,现在有一个薄的 CLI 层 —— 不需要代理进程,在持有会话目录的任何机器上都能直接跑:

```bash
bili sessions ls                 # id、label、解码后大小、最后更新时间、存储状态(active/archived)
bili sessions rm <id>            # 完整删除(释放内容引用计数,含媒体);随后收缩 index.db(--no-vacuum 跳过)
bili sessions archive <id>       # 导出到 archive/archive.jsonl + 清行;tombstone 保留 label 与身份
bili sessions restore <id>       # 从日志行恢复已归档的会话

billion-context README · 存储维护 CLI（#3928）：`archive`/`restore`/`gc` 需要统一存储(`BILI_STORAGE_UNIFIED=shadow|full` 或配置文件里的 `storage.unified`)—— legacy-only 安装会拒绝并给出提示。`--days` 默认取 `storage.archiveAfterDays`(365)。没有调度器:全部按需运行。所有命令都支持 `--json`。

billion-context README · 存储维护 CLI（#3928）：**大库上 full vacuum 是离线操作(#4612)。** `--vacuum full`(默认)会在独占写锁下重写整个 index.db —— O(库大小),多 GB 的库要几分钟到几十分钟,且没有中间进度(SQLite 的 VACUUM 是原子操作,拆不开)。在有代理正从同一会话目录服务时跑它,会把那个代理的写入饿死到其存储层降级为止,所以 `storage gc --vacuum full` **在另一个存活进程持有该数据库时会拒绝启动**(`index.db.lock` pid 纪律,#4175):CLI 以退出码 1 给出可操作提示,面板端点返回 HTTP 409。先停掉另一个实例(或等它退出)再重试;要在线安全地缩库用 `--vacuum incremental`,它以短事务回收空闲页、不拿独占锁。零引用删除清扫无论哪种模式都分批执行并逐批打印进度。
